links.outcome: LLM treatment recommendation concordance with multidisciplinary tumor board decisions as comparator
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o 83.2%, Claude 3.7 Sonnet 79.7%, Gemini 2.5 Pro 79.4% overall concordance; Luminal A ~66%; mastectomy F1 <58; axillary dissection F1 ≤23.5.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o demonstrated the highest overall concordance with MDTB decisions (83.2%), followed by Claude 3.7 Sonnet (79.7%) and Gemini 2.5 Pro (79.4%).

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark comparing LLM-generated breast cancer treatment recommendations against institutional multidisciplinary tumor board decisions without evaluating a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
